label: development check of the PREREG v1.5 code; not confirmatory
task: W19 P1.4: development check of the PREREG v1.5 two-CF code on medium (R2' = R2 + icf, C4 = R2' + E2)

policy_settings.prereg: v1.5.1 (secondary replication of the v1.4 policy with C4 as the base)

commands.equivalent: python -m nbr tune --profile medium --dataset instacart (lr_repeat.itemcf_feature = true in memory)
python -m nbr evaluate --profile medium --dataset instacart --skip-l3 --policy (lr_repeat.itemcf_feature = true in memory)
python -m nbr tune --profile medium --dataset complete_journey (lr_repeat.itemcf_feature = true in memory)
python -m nbr evaluate --profile medium --dataset complete_journey --skip-l3 --policy (lr_repeat.itemcf_feature = true in memory)

icf.definition: icf(u, i) = log(1 + sum over j in I(H_u) of sim(j, i)), sim from the top-n cosine item-neighbour lists of the binary user x item matrix of the scored history (self excluded)

H15_ndcg.rule: improvement observed if the 0.975 lower bound > 0
